This has been my go-to hotel every time I visit Gurgaon—I’ve stayed here on my last four trips. The hotel is extremely customer-oriented. The staff are polite and courteous, and I’d like to especially mention Ms. Meena Thakur, who managed the morning buffet during my stay. I was truly impressed by her managerial skills. In fact, every staff member I interacted with was highly professional and excellent at their job.

The food menu is diverse, offering a wide range of cuisines including Indian, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. The hotel also features amenities such as a nightclub, salon, gym, and a massage parlor equipped with a Jacuzzi. Some of the special rooms also come with private Jacuzzis.

While the rooms are slightly compact, the layout and furniture placement are so well-planned that they still feel quite spacious. The hotel also has specially designed rooms for old aged guests, making their stay more comfortable and accessible.

Overall, I had a wonderful experience staying here and would highly recommend it.

I stayed at this hotel for a week, and the experience was extremely disappointing. The service was among the worst I’ve encountered. On one occasion, the breakfast staff told me that breakfast wouldn’t be available because I had already eaten in the morning — an utterly unprofessional and rude way to speak to a guest.

If there were extra charges for additional breakfast, they could have simply informed me politely, rather than refusing service outright. During my entire stay, I only had breakfast on 3–4 days, yet this was the treatment I received.

Given my experience, I would never recommend this hotel to anyone.
